reason: `ModelFallback`'s default `fallback_on` adds `OutputTokenLimitExceeded`, so it falls back when a response is cut off at `max_tokens` (`finish_reason='length'`), whose text would otherwise be the output and look complete. Falling back is what the capability exists for, as with `ContentFilterError` in #12039; `fallback_on=(ModelAPIError, ContentFilterError)` restores the previous default. `FallbackModel` and the core agent's handling of cut-off responses are unchanged.
